content.title: Careers at Blackstone - Blackstone
content.text: Our Most Valuable Asset Training Blackstone is committed to offering learning and development opportunities to help advance our employees’ careers across a number of areas: investing skills, leadership and management, communication and technology, among others. Building Stronger Workplaces We seek to attract and retain the brightest minds across a wide spectrum of disciplines. We believe that teams of individuals with varied backgrounds and experiences make better business decisions. Our approach centers on four pillars: recruiting, talent development, community inclusion and accountability. Learn More About Our Efforts Benefits Our employee benefits are considered comprehensive and competitive. In addition to robust health and retirement offerings, we provide our employees with a wide variety of quality of life benefits, including time-off options and perks like well-being and family planning resources. Read More Blackstone has a formal recruitment policy. Search firms interested in working with Blackstone should contact the Human Resources team to ensure Terms & Conditions are agreed upon before introducing candidates or engaging in work.Phishing Messages Alert:Blackstone has recently become aware of fraudulent emails, texts and social media messages purporting to offer employment at Blackstone and misusing the official Blackstone logo. These messages do not originate from Blackstone or any of our affiliates. If you have received any such messages, you should not click any links in the messages or provide any personal information (e.g., your social security number or scans of identity documents).
